TUN.note: Customs AI is not about harms from AI.
Only a customs system, which belongs to the sectoral study.

facts.fact: Tunisian Customs spokesman Chokri Jabri said on 12 October 2026 that customs is about to integrate AI to adapt risk-targeting criteria automatically and that first trials improved targeting quality by 20 to 25 percent, with AI also to analyse container-scanner images.

TUN.note: No locally built model, dataset or AI computing stated.
